messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired: Synthetics-APAC-Canary — high failure rate (5xx > 20% over 3m). https://redwood.internal/alerts/6500002222 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Alert assigned to Kai (on-call). Incident key: PD-APAC-SYNTH-6500.
Kai: acking, jumping on it. grabbing dashboards now — what region exactly?
Maria: APAC/SIN prober group. Dashboards show a sharp spike in probe 503s and synthetic latency around 12:43 UTC. https://dashboards.redwood/probes/apac/sin
Ash: looking at prober logs — getting 503s from edge-rt pool. sample tail:```
2026-03-15T12:43:12Z prober/sin INFO request failed status=503 path=/healthcheck id=cb-7a
2026-03-15T12:43:12Z edge-rt WARN backend=nlb-12 retries=0 reason="rate_limited"
2026-03-15T12:43:13Z prober/sin INFO requeued backoff=1200ms
```
Lee: that looks like the regional edge rate-limiter kicking in. we saw similar after the last deploy. can we mute synthetic fanout so PD stops firing repeatedly? :pray:
Kai: yes. putting synth suppression for apac on now. command:```redwoodctl synth mute --region apac --duration 20m --reason "investigating 503 surge"```
Incident Bot: synth checks for region apac suppressed for 20m by Kai. PagerDuty incident remains acknowledged.
Jordan: recommendation: reduce probe concurrency and increase retry/backoff on prober fleet, then re-enable gradually. also consider routing heavy customers to eu1 if they show issues.
Maria: customer impact: support only has 2 inbound tickets from APAC customers reporting slower responses; no widespread error reports in prod logs yet. tagging those customers and sending an FYI.
Ash: rolling a quick config to prober group to drop concurrency from 50 -> 10 and backoff from 500ms -> 1500ms. applying now:```kubectl -n synth scale deployment/prober-sin --replicas=3 && kubectl set env deployment/prober-sin PROBER_CONCURRENCY=10 PROBER_BACKOFF_MS=1500```
Lee: acked, watching error budget and http 5xx rate. adding a temporary circuit-breaker on requests to edge-rt in region to reduce load.
Kai: handoff: I'm going offline for a customer call in 10. Lee, you're primary for the next 30m — escalate to Jordan if pages resume. I'll check back at +35m. :white_check_mark:
Lee: got it — taking over. will post status updates every 5m and unmute synth once 5xx < 2% for 2 consecutive 1m windows.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty status: acknowledged -> suppressed (synth checks muted). Next PD escalation will be manual if new alerts bypass suppression.
Maria: filing a quick incident ticket and creating a postmortem stub. assigning to SRE and Eng-Infra for follow-up. ticket: https://issues.redwood/INC-650000
Jordan: thumbs — once we stabilize, let's check the recent edge-rt kernel changes from last deploy. might be related to connection limits.
Lee: monitoring — will update in 5m.
Incident Bot: thread closed for active paging; synth suppression active until 20m. remember to unmute or extend if needed. :information_source:
